milestone.name: string
milestone.acceptance: array of strings: gate that must pass before the next milestone starts
milestone.tasks: array of task objects, ordered; position = current_task_index

task.index: integer, 0-based position inside the milestone's tasks array
task.title: string
task.description: string: one isolated, bite-sized unit of work
task.requires_human: optional string: why a person must do or approve this task; autopilot stops here

every decision produces audit record and business event

tasks.title: Web auth and session

tasks.title: Browser bundle secret test

tasks.title: Plan and build report

tasks.done_when: Both files exist and reflect final test results.

tasks.title: Live Supabase: apply migrations
tasks.description: Start Docker, install Supabase CLI, run `supabase start` so 0001 and 0002 apply on real Supabase.
tasks.done_when: `supabase start` completes with no migration errors.

tasks.title: Live Supabase: verify role assumptions
tasks.description: Confirm the postgres role owns public tables (bypasses RLS) and can `SET ROLE authenticated`.

tasks.title: Live Supabase: verify seed and sign-in

tasks.done_when: All three walkthrough steps behave as documented.
